scope: Retrospective, meaning-matched basic concepts explicitly represented by the proposed key's literal visual or target meanings. This is not an independent semantic assignment or a preregistration.
inclusion_rule: Use distinct ordinary basic meanings in DravLex whose proposed root and sense can be linked to a specific DEDR entry in the existing key. Freeze entries, rather than accepting every homonym of a key spelling. Do not add young plant as generic tree, hump as generic back, or bend as generic nose. General small/cikka is unresolved and omitted. Moon and sit remain listed even if the elicited data do not provide an identifiable target cognate class.
